_readme: Manual values. Any metric here with a non-null value replaces the same key in stats.public.json on the page. Set value to null to hide it. Keys starting with _ are ignored. The daily Action never edits this file.

returningViewers._note: Not available from the YouTube Analytics API. Copy from YouTube Studio > Analytics > Audience. Example: value 0.42 with unit percent, or 5200 with unit count.
returningViewers.label: Returning viewers

audienceAge._note: Optional, shown under 'Who they are' only when value is set. Free text, e.g. 'Most viewers are 18–34'.
audienceAge.label: Age

audienceGender._note: Optional, shown under 'Who they are' only when value is set. Free text.
audienceGender.label: Gender

firstDaysViews._note: The page fills in exact dates from the video's publish date once the Action has run.
firstDaysViews.label: Views in its first 5 days
